beliefs.label: Worth Knowing
beliefs.statement: I am worth knowing even when I am not entertaining.

receipts.quote: At Mara's birthday I went quiet after the first hour. I worried everyone had noticed I was not carrying the table.
I skipped telling a story at dinner because I had none ready. I still stayed until the plates were cleared.

beliefs.label: Repairing Something
beliefs.statement: Repairing something together can make a relationship stronger.

receipts.quote: Mara and I rebuilt the crooked shelf in my kitchen. We laughed when the first bracket landed backward.
After I forgot our errand, I helped Mara haul paper stock upstairs. The work made talking easier.

beliefs.label: Need Motion
beliefs.statement: I need motion before I can think clearly.

receipts.quote: Before answering my landlord, I rode three miles along the river. By the bridge I knew what I needed to say.
A bad customer review sat in my inbox all morning. I walked the greenway before writing back.

beliefs.label: Say Favor
beliefs.statement: I say when a favor has become too much.

receipts.quote: Mara asked if I could staff her Saturday workshop. I said I had already promised my nephew a ride and offered Monday.
When a neighbor kept adding bikes to my list, I told him I could do two this week. He chose the red one.

beliefs.label: Believe Apologies
beliefs.statement: I believe apologies need a changed action behind them.

receipts.quote: I apologized to Mara for missing the market, then showed up early for the rescheduled one. I knew words alone would feel thin.
A regular customer got a second flat after my repair. I replaced the tube free and checked the rim with him.

beliefs.label: Joke First
beliefs.statement: I joke first when I feel exposed.

receipts.quote: When Mara said I had canceled twice, I made a joke about becoming a ghost. Then I admitted I had been avoiding the conversation.
My sister asked why I was distant, and I made her laugh first. A minute later I told her I felt embarrassed.

beliefs.label: People Deserve
beliefs.statement: People deserve to understand what was fixed and why.

receipts.quote: I handed a customer her old chain beside the new one. I showed her the rusted links before she paid.
I drew the brake cable route on a receipt for a kid at the clinic. He fixed the next step himself.

beliefs.label: Keep One
beliefs.statement: I keep one day each week without appointments.

receipts.quote: I blocked Wednesdays on the shop calendar and ignored three booking requests. I went to the woods with a sandwich.
A client offered extra money for my day off. I said no and spent the morning at the library.

shared_items.label: How I mean things
shared_items.statement: I circle the point with a joke before I say it.

shared_items.label: What feels like care
shared_items.statement: Doing a task beside me feels more caring than checking in repeatedly.

shared_items.label: How to bring something up with me
shared_items.statement: Tell me what happened, not what kind of person you think I am.
